# M21-S1: logos lsp proxies gopls over a mixed workspace. A client written
# the way an editor is (no editor-specific code) opens a loGo/s file and a
# Go file, asks for definitions across kinds and inside a ? statement,
# breaks the loGo/s file to see compiler diagnostics, repairs it, and
# checks that the workspace gained no file. If gopls is not on PATH the
# script skips, and the gate is blocked and incomplete (record it as such).
[!exec:gopls] skip
[short] skip

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOFLAGS=
mkdir $WORK/home
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CACHE_HOME=$WORK/home/cache
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/home/config

cd client
exec go run . ../ws
stdout '^ok initialize drops diagnosticProvider$'
stdout '^ok definition of a loGo/s symbol from a Go file lands in the .lgo file$'
stdout '^ok definition of a Go symbol from a loGo/s file lands in the .go file$'
stdout '^ok definition inside a \? statement maps back to the .lgo parameter$'
stdout '^ok hover inside a \? statement$'
stdout '^ok compiler diagnostic reaches publishDiagnostics at the .lgo position$'
stdout '^ok requests on a loGo/s file that does not compile answer null$'
stdout '^ok diagnostics clear after the repair$'
stdout '^ok the workspace gained no file$'
stdout '^ok shutdown$'
! stderr .

-- client/go.mod --
module lspclient

go 1.27
-- client/main.go --
// Command lspclient drives logos lsp over the workspace in its first
// argument, as an editor would, and checks the answers.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type message struct {
	JSONRPC string          `json:"jsonrpc"`
	ID      json.RawMessage `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Method  string          `json:"method,omitempty"`
	Params  json.RawMessage `json:"params,omitempty"`
	Result  json.RawMessage `json:"result,omitempty"`
	Error   json.RawMessage `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type position struct {
	Line      int `json:"line"`
	Character int `json:"character"`
}

type location struct {
	URI   string `json:"uri"`
	Range struct {
		Start position `json:"start"`
	} `json:"range"`
}

type session struct {
	in     io.Writer
	msgs   chan message
	notes  []message
	nextID int
}

const wait = 180 * time.Second

func fail(format string, args ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "FAIL: "+format+"\n", args...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func must(ok bool, format string, args ...any) {
	if !ok {
		fail(format, args...)
	}
}

func (s *session) send(m message) {
	m.JSONRPC = "2.0"
	body, err := json.Marshal(m)
	if err != nil {
		fail("%v", err)
	}
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(s.in, "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s", len(body), body); err != nil {
		fail("writing to logos lsp: %v", err)
	}
}

func (s *session) pump(r io.Reader) {
	br := bufio.NewReader(r)
	for {
		n := -1
		for {
			line, err := br.ReadString('\n')
			if err != nil {
				close(s.msgs)
				return
			}
			line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
			if line == "" {
				break
			}
			if v, ok := strings.CutPrefix(line, "Content-Length: "); ok {
				n, _ = strconv.Atoi(v)
			}
		}
		body := make([]byte, n)
		if _, err := io.ReadFull(br, body); err != nil {
			close(s.msgs)
			return
		}
		var m message
		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &m); err != nil {
			fail("bad message %q: %v", body, err)
		}
		s.msgs <- m
	}
}

func (s *session) next() message {
	select {
	case m, ok := <-s.msgs:
		must(ok, "logos lsp closed its output early")
		return m
	case <-time.After(wait):
		fail("timed out waiting for logos lsp")
		return message{}
	}
}

func (s *session) absorb(m message) {
	if m.Method != "" && len(m.ID) > 0 {
		s.send(message{ID: m.ID, Result: json.RawMessage("null")})
		return
	}
	if m.Method != "" {
		s.notes = append(s.notes, m)
	}
}

func (s *session) notify(method string, params any) {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(params)
	s.send(message{Method: method, Params: raw})
}

func (s *session) call(method string, params any) json.RawMessage {
	s.nextID++
	id := strconv.Itoa(s.nextID)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(params)
	s.send(message{ID: json.RawMessage(id), Method: method, Params: raw})
	for {
		m := s.next()
		if m.Method == "" && string(m.ID) == id {
			must(len(m.Error) == 0, "%s failed: %s", method, m.Error)
			return m.Result
		}
		s.absorb(m)
	}
}

func (s *session) mark() int { return len(s.notes) }

func (s *session) note(since int, method string, accept func(map[string]any) bool) map[string]any {
	for from := since; ; {
		for ; from < len(s.notes); from++ {
			n := s.notes[from]
			var params map[string]any
			if n.Method == method && json.Unmarshal(n.Params, &params) == nil && accept(params) {
				return params
			}
		}
		s.absorb(s.next())
	}
}

func uri(path string) string { return "file://" + filepath.ToSlash(path) }

func doc(path string) map[string]any { return map[string]any{"uri": uri(path)} }

func find(text, needle string, nth int) position {
	off := -1
	for i := 0; i <= nth; i++ {
		j := strings.Index(text[off+1:], needle)
		must(j >= 0, "%q not found in the text", needle)
		off += 1 + j
	}
	before := text[:off]
	line := strings.Count(before, "\n")
	return position{Line: line, Character: off - (strings.LastIndex(before, "\n") + 1)}
}

func definition(s *session, path string, at position) []location {
	raw := s.call("textDocument/definition", map[string]any{"textDocument": doc(path), "position": at})
	var locs []location
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &locs); err != nil || len(locs) == 0 {
		var one location
		must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &one) == nil && one.URI != "", "definition answered %s", raw)
		locs = []location{one}
	}
	return locs
}

func files(root string) []string {
	var out []string
	filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err == nil && !d.IsDir() {
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, path)
			out = append(out, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
		}
		return nil
	})
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

func read(path string) string {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err == nil, "%v", err)
	return string(data)
}

func main() {
	root, err := filepath.Abs(os.Args[1])
	must(err == nil, "%v", err)
	before := files(root)
	aPath := filepath.Join(root, "lmod", "a", "a.lgo")
	bPath := filepath.Join(root, "gomod", "b", "b.go")
	cPath := filepath.Join(root, "lmod", "c", "c.lgo")
	dPath := filepath.Join(root, "gomod", "d", "d.go")
	aText, bText, cText, dText := read(aPath), read(bPath), read(cPath), read(dPath)

	cmd := exec.Command("logos", "lsp")
	cmd.Dir = root
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	stdin, err := cmd.StdinPipe()
	must(err == nil, "%v", err)
	stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
	must(err == nil, "%v", err)
	must(cmd.Start() == nil, "starting logos lsp")
	s := &session{in: stdin, msgs: make(chan message, 1024)}
	go s.pump(stdout)

	init := s.call("initialize", map[string]any{
		"processId":        nil,
		"rootUri":          uri(root),
		"workspaceFolders": []any{map[string]any{"uri": uri(root), "name": "ws"}},
		"capabilities": map[string]any{
			"general": map[string]any{"positionEncodings": []string{"utf-16"}},
		},
	})
	must(!bytes.Contains(init, []byte("diagnosticProvider")), "initialize result keeps diagnosticProvider: %s", init)
	fmt.Println("ok initialize drops diagnosticProvider")
	s.notify("initialized", map[string]any{})

	open := func(path, lang, text string, version int) {
		s.notify("textDocument/didOpen", map[string]any{"textDocument": map[string]any{
			"uri": uri(path), "languageId": lang, "version": version, "text": text,
		}})
	}
	open(bPath, "go", bText, 1)
	open(aPath, "logos", aText, 1)
	open(cPath, "logos", cText, 1)

	at := find(bText, "a.Read", 0)
	at.Character += len("a.")
	locs := definition(s, bPath, at)
	want := find(aText, "Read(path", 0)
	must(locs[0].URI == uri(aPath) && locs[0].Range.Start == want,
		"definition of a.Read = %+v, want %s at %+v", locs[0], uri(aPath), want)
	fmt.Println("ok definition of a loGo/s symbol from a Go file lands in the .lgo file")

	at = find(cText, "d.Thing", 0)
	at.Character += len("d.")
	locs = definition(s, cPath, at)
	want = find(dText, "Thing(", 0)
	must(locs[0].URI == uri(dPath) && locs[0].Range.Start == want,
		"definition of d.Thing = %+v, want %s at %+v", locs[0], uri(dPath), want)
	fmt.Println("ok definition of a Go symbol from a loGo/s file lands in the .go file")

	operand := find(aText, "ReadFile(path)?", 0)
	operand.Character += len("ReadFile(")
	locs = definition(s, aPath, operand)
	want = find(aText, "path string", 0)
	must(locs[0].URI == uri(aPath) && locs[0].Range.Start == want,
		"definition of the operand = %+v, want %s at %+v", locs[0], uri(aPath), want)
	fmt.Println("ok definition inside a ? statement maps back to the .lgo parameter")

	hover := s.call("textDocument/hover", map[string]any{
		"textDocument": doc(aPath),
		"position":     find(aText, "ReadFile(path)?", 0),
	})
	must(bytes.Contains(hover, []byte("ReadFile")), "hover inside the ? statement answered %s", hover)
	fmt.Println("ok hover inside a ? statement")

	broken := strings.Replace(aText, "return string(data), nil", "return undefinedName, nil", 1)
	since := s.mark()
	s.notify("textDocument/didChange", map[string]any{
		"textDocument":   map[string]any{"uri": uri(aPath), "version": 2},
		"contentChanges": []any{map[string]any{"text": broken}},
	})
	null := s.call("textDocument/hover", map[string]any{"textDocument": doc(aPath), "position": operand})
	must(string(null) == "null", "hover on a file that does not compile answered %s", null)
	line := find(broken, "undefinedName", 0).Line
	diag := s.note(since, "textDocument/publishDiagnostics", func(p map[string]any) bool {
		items, _ := p["diagnostics"].([]any)
		for _, item := range items {
			m, _ := item.(map[string]any)
			msg, _ := m["message"].(string)
			r, _ := m["range"].(map[string]any)
			st, _ := r["start"].(map[string]any)
			l, _ := st["line"].(float64)
			if p["uri"] == uri(aPath) && strings.Contains(msg, "undefined") && int(l) == line {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	})
	_ = diag
	fmt.Println("ok compiler diagnostic reaches publishDiagnostics at the .lgo position")
	fmt.Println("ok requests on a loGo/s file that does not compile answer null")

	since = s.mark()
	s.notify("textDocument/didChange", map[string]any{
		"textDocument":   map[string]any{"uri": uri(aPath), "version": 3},
		"contentChanges": []any{map[string]any{"text": aText}},
	})
	hover = s.call("textDocument/hover", map[string]any{"textDocument": doc(aPath), "position": find(aText, "ReadFile(path)?", 0)})
	must(bytes.Contains(hover, []byte("ReadFile")), "hover after the repair answered %s", hover)
	s.note(since, "textDocument/publishDiagnostics", func(p map[string]any) bool {
		items, _ := p["diagnostics"].([]any)
		return p["uri"] == uri(aPath) && len(items) == 0
	})
	fmt.Println("ok diagnostics clear after the repair")

	after := files(root)
	must(slices.Equal(before, after), "the workspace changed: %v -> %v", before, after)
	fmt.Println("ok the workspace gained no file")

	s.call("shutdown", nil)
	s.notify("exit", nil)
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
	select {
	case err := <-done:
		must(err == nil, "logos lsp exited with %v", err)
	case <-time.After(wait):
		fail("logos lsp did not exit after exit")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok shutdown")
}
-- ws/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./lmod
	./gomod
)
-- ws/lmod/go.mod --
module example.com/lmod

go 1.27
-- ws/lmod/a/a.lgo --
package a

import "os"

func Read(path string) (string, error) {
	data := os.ReadFile(path)?
	return string(data), nil
}
-- ws/lmod/c/c.lgo --
package c

import "example.com/gomod/d"

func Use() int {
	return d.Thing()
}
-- ws/gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gomod

go 1.27

require example.com/lmod v0.0.0

replace example.com/lmod => ../lmod
-- ws/gomod/b/b.go --
package b

import "example.com/lmod/a"

func Use() (string, error) {
	return a.Read("x")
}
-- ws/gomod/d/d.go --
package d

func Thing() int { return 1 }
